content.text:
**Analyzing Grid Changes**

I'm reviewing the recent grid transformations. Specifically, I'm trying to reconcile why a value of 2 at (9,4) appears to have become 3, while the value at (8,4) remained unchanged. I'm also noting the introduction of a value at (8,3).
